lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a structured lattice pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple smaller teleost fish are visible in the ventral water column, clustered primarily beneath the pectoral fin and mid-body trunk.
